claim: The only way to create a new reality is to question the current one
name: Questioning your beliefs

claim: When you question your reality: "You are not stuck"
name: Questioning your beliefs

claim: To question your reality, look at where you feel stuck, not good enough, or where you think "I wish"
name: Questioning your beliefs

claim: A test to question your reality: would somebody looking from the outside, who sees only your current skills, knowledge and experience, without your usual story, say it is impossible for you? Or that you could do it as much as anyone else?
name: Questioning your beliefs

claim: Just as we need to question the "bullshit propaganda" fed through the media, question the propaganda we feed ourselves: "I'm stuck in this job, I'm stuck in this relationship", stuck in a physical habit or a weight
name: Questioning your beliefs

claim: When you feel stuck, ask whether there is any evidence in the physical world for the limit
name: Questioning your beliefs

claim: About your limits, the real truth is "so much more awesome" than the story sold from the outside or the one sold from the inside
name: Questioning your beliefs

claim: A Reddit post asked for testosterone supplements without side effects. Lots of men have searched for the best testosterone supplements, personally included
About testosterone, ask the right question: most men probably care less about a lab number than about how they feel: erections, energy, strength, being lean
Raising testosterone matters, but the end goal is the feeling: how you feel
Testosterone is built from habits and fuel, not supplements
Some supplements are useful, but without the foundation of habits and fuel for testosterone, no supplement can save you
Only with every item of the testosterone foundation done, and still wanting a boost, might supplements have a place
If you feel your testosterone is low, or have been told so, start with the foundation of habits and fuel, not supplements, "and it's certainly not with testosterone therapy"
Do the testosterone foundation of habits and fuel consistently and it would be shocking to still have testosterone issues
Don't dismiss the items of the testosterone foundation as too simple: simple things are powerful, positively when done and as a drag when not
The items of the testosterone foundation come in no particular order, all key
As an item of the testosterone foundation, water's effect on how you feel, erections, energy and mind "cannot be understated"
name: Water and hydration

claim: Many people may never have felt truly hydrated
name: Water and hydration

claim: Water formula given to clients and people: body weight in pounds ÷ 2 + 20 = ounces a day
name: Water and hydration

claim: At 200 pounds, the water formula (body weight in pounds ÷ 2 + 20) gives 120 ounces a day, close to a gallon (128 ounces)
name: Water and hydration

claim: A gallon of water a day is a good target for most men
name: Water and hydration

claim: Very small men might get away with less than a gallon of water a day
name: Water and hydration

claim: Men of 250–300 pounds or more may need more than a gallon of water a day
name: Water and hydration

claim: Only after two to four weeks in a row at the target amount of water do you know what being truly hydrated feels like
name: Water and hydration

claim: Beyond its effect on testosterone, water helps erections, strength, energy and staying lean
name: Water and hydration

claim: Hormones are made primarily during sleep, so messing up sleep messes up hormones directly, even if every other item of the testosterone foundation is right
Get enough sleep: for most people something like 7–8 hours, around 7.5
For sleep and hormones, don't eat too close to bed
When you eat too close to bed, digestion pulls blood and energy away from other areas, so the body works on food instead of hormones
On eating too close to bed: "It'll crush your hormones, it'll crush your erections"
Even the same junk, eaten three hours before bed, would be better than eating it close to bed
Years of eating junk right up to bedtime without noticing what it did
Avoid screens late at night: blue light hurts sleep quality
Better sleep quality means better hormone production

As an item of the testosterone foundation, super clean eating means eating what grows: the produce section, healthy fats (macadamia nuts, coconut oil, red palm oil, avocado oil, olive oil), pasture-raised meat and wild cold-water fish
name: Clean eating

claim: Anything beyond what grows, healthy fats, pasture-raised meat and wild cold-water fish, including fast food and takeout, is not what counts as super clean eating here, though takeout might not be the worst (personally, much worse has been eaten)
name: Clean eating

claim: Super clean eating is not necessarily for life, but it is how to know you support your body
name: Clean eating

claim: You don't need a PhD to understand super clean eating, but you do need the commitment, and putting it into action is not necessarily easy
name: Clean eating

claim: On super clean eating: "We are our habits and our fuel"
name: Clean eating

claim: For testosterone, eat enough healthy fats, especially monounsaturated: avocado oil, olive oil and macadamia nuts
Healthy fats are key building blocks for hormones
If you're really deficient in healthy fats, producing enough testosterone is hard
For testosterone, eat enough carbs, as covered in earlier episodes
name: Carbs and low carb

claim: Low carb is a bigger discussion, but in short, going low carb is "a very dangerous thing" for testosterone
name: Carbs and low carb

claim: "Plenty of studies" show low carb and testosterone don't go well together
name: Carbs and low carb

claim: Get lean by doing everything else and grinding hard, not by cutting carbs
name: Carbs and low carb

claim: Healthy carbs means produce like potatoes, not crackers and bread
name: Carbs and low carb

claim: For testosterone, avoid sugar and alcohol
name: Alcohol

claim: Wanting better testosterone while still drinking is "not gonna happen"
name: Alcohol

claim: Stop drinking and testosterone will improve: "I guarantee it"
name: Alcohol

claim: Personally, there is possibly no worse habit than drinking for cancelling out the good ones, so cut back dramatically or stop
name: Alcohol

claim: After drinking, the liver takes four to five days to fully detox the alcohol and basically stops detoxing anything else meanwhile
name: Alcohol

claim: Because the liver basically stops detoxing anything else while it detoxes alcohol, beyond alcohol's depressive effect, toxins build up, even from regular moderate drinking
name: Alcohol

claim: Drinking more is your choice, but recognize it will have an impact on your hormones and how you feel
name: Alcohol

claim: Years of drinking, a lot in some of them, then a little, then a bit here and there. On any regular basis, drinking drags you down
name: Alcohol

claim: Exercise, one item of the testosterone foundation
For testosterone, exercise every day
For testosterone, exercise for strength, not cardio or long and slow
To boost testosterone, boost your strength: push hard, pull hard, squat hard
For testosterone, do sprints two to three times a week
"So many studies" show sprints boost testosterone, and the payoff is huge
For testosterone, work the big muscles of the legs with squats and sprints
The more muscle fibers you activate, the bigger the hormonal response, and the big muscles hold the most fibers
Sprinting works everything "full bore"
For testosterone, raise the intensity of your exercise
With everything else in the testosterone foundation right but sex energy drained, testosterone may even test fine while you "feel like shit", a shadow of who you could be
A key of sex energy for testosterone: stop jerking off to porn
A key of sex energy for testosterone: ejaculate less often, since each time "hits the reset button" on sexual energy
A key of sex energy for testosterone: practice semen retention
A key of sex energy for testosterone: edge
A key of sex energy for testosterone: move the energy through your body
For most men, the keys of sex energy for testosterone (stop jerking off to porn, ejaculate less often, practice semen retention, edge, move the energy through your body) are a big ask: a change
Studies over one or two weeks of semen retention show testosterone boosts, though they don't fully cover the practice
With semen retention, the testosterone number goes up, but how you feel changes even more
Stress hormones like cortisol, essentially negative hormones for the most part, serve a role, but we generally have too many of them
Stress hormones like cortisol have sort of an inverse relationship with testosterone and other feel-good hormones: the higher the cortisol, the lower the testosterone
Constant stress crushes hormone production and also affects goals like losing weight or better erections
Any kind of activity can help release stress
The two big ways to change how stress works in you are meditation and being in the present
Being in the now sounds like just words until you feel it
Of being in the now, most people only get brief glimpses: flying downhill on a mountain bike, or moments in sex when everything else fades
Learning to get back to being in the now transforms your life
Being in the now is a constant journey of getting pulled out and coming back
Book on being in the now: *The Power of Now* by Eckhart Tolle, audiobook or print
*The Power of Now* by Eckhart Tolle is not necessarily the only way to understand being in the now, but for a lot of people it helps: "I cannot recommend that book highly enough"
Life before *The Power of Now* by Eckhart Tolle and life after it, with a completely shifted inner state
Don't write being in the now off as hollow
Being in the now is a huge thing, maybe one of the biggest, and the only way to see how big is to feel it
The body responds to the needs you place on it: strength training signals a need for strength, and the body answers with more testosterone
For testosterone, a life purpose places on the body the same kind of need that strength training places
name: Purpose

claim: You do have a purpose, even if you think you don't
name: Purpose

claim: Without being in touch with your purpose, or at least on the journey to find it, a life purpose does not really place its need on the body
name: Purpose

claim: Being stuck in a job you hate and dread feels like the opposite of high testosterone
name: Purpose

claim: Live in an aggressive way: go after what you want, have a purpose, commit to it, and the body responds with a hormone boost
name: Purpose

A few supplements in personal use, for the brain and for erections
